task_defect.reason: 1) R29 and R31 directly conflict regarding the single column F48:F60 ('Amount (yards/Pounds)'): R31 requires each raw material's total quantity to equal the exact sum of per-run requirements across all runs, whereas R29 requires planned quantities to be rounded up to whole package sizes from 'Raw Material Purchased Parts and Tooling.xlsx' (and R10 forbids adding extra columns). 2) In 'FG BOM Requirement.xlsx', column E ('Raw Pounds') states 20.0 for all parts, while the footnote in A45 states 'Consuming 50 pounds of polymer (TPO)... for each unit produced'. 3) In 'Week One Test Plan.xlsx', cell A46 says 'Team Member Labor Total (Minutes Rounded Up Whole)' while cell B47 says 'Total Hours'.
